home.introBody: Map-6 is a free interactive GTA 6 map and guide hub for Leonida: Vice City, Ocean Drive, Grassrivers, Port Gellhorn, the Keys, and more. Use the map to filter landmarks and collectibles, copy coordinates, measure distances, and share deep links. Read regional guides and sourced news when you need context — we label speculation and we do not invent leaks. Community basemap tiles are attributed to GTADB (CC BY 4.0) where used.

faq.a1: Map-6 is a free interactive map and editorial site for GTA 6 (Leonida / Vice City). It combines MapLibre map tools — filters, coordinates, measure, shareable links — with location guides, collectible category pages, and news that cites official sources when stating facts. It is a fan project, not affiliated with Rockstar Games or Take-Two.
faq.q2: How do I find collectibles on the GTA 6 map?
faq.a2: Open the interactive map and filter by Collectibles, or start from /collectibles for category explainers (hidden packages, stunt jumps, street art, wildlife). Pre-launch totals are placeholders — Rockstar has not published final counts. Use Share to copy a pin deep link for friends.
faq.a3: No. Map tiles and many landmarks come from the GTADB / GTA VI Mapping Community under CC BY 4.0, plus Map-6 editorial hubs. We update as the community releases new data. Always verify pins in the retail game after launch.
faq.a4: Rockstar / Take-Two have communicated a console launch date of November 19, 2026 for PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S. PC timing is separate and should be treated as unconfirmed here until Rockstar announces it. Map-6 will keep map tools updated around launch week.
faq.q5: Is Map-6 free? Do you show ads?
faq.a5: Yes, the map and guides are free. We may show clearly labeled Google AdSense units on content pages (not on the fullscreen map/overlay) and disclosed Amazon affiliate links. See About and Privacy for details.
